1. (Currently amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type 1b (BVDV-1b) __that is cytopathic__, [[and ]]a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

2. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus is a cytopathic BVDV-1b virus.

3. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 1a (BVDV-1a), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, __wherein the composition is free of inactivated bacteria cultures of Leptospira__.

4. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type 1a, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, __wherein the composition is free of inactivated bacteria cultures of Leptospira__.

6. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen, __wherein the at least a first antigen is a viral antigen__.

7. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is specific for an organism selected from the group consisting of [[Actinobacillus, Actinomyces, Bacillus, Bordetella, Brachyspira, Campylobacter, Clostridium, Ehrlichia, Erysipelothrix, Escherichia, Histophilus, Leptospira, Listeria, Mannheimia, Moraxella, Mycobacterium, Mycoplasma, Pasteurella, Salmonella, and Streptococcus, or a combination thereof]] __PI3, BRSV, BHV-1, BVDV-1a, BVDV-2, and IBR virus, or a combination thereof__.

8. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated __viral antigen__.

12. (Currently amended) The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of [[a least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen]] __at least one viral pathogen-specific antigen__.
